notes: ⏳ Fixed a wording contradiction on the report card's decay line. The grading self-audit ('Does the grading work?') correctly reports that badge-earning edges have, on this history, gone from +0.26% in the badge window to +0.82% in the window after — they STRENGTHENED, not faded. But the ⏳ line on the pick card was hardcoded to describe fading ('kept X% of themselves', 'after the typical fade') and had no wording for the case where edges grow — so it was quietly describing the opposite of what the data shows. The card now reads the direction honestly: 'Edges held up: actually STRENGTHENED, not faded' when they grow, 'kept ~X%' when they genuinely fade, and 'did NOT survive' when they collapse — matching the audit report exactly. The per-line figure follows suit ('if it holds like the average badge' vs 'after the typical fade'). Display only; the numbers were always right, only the words were wrong.
